_note: Persian words the voice misreads → the spoken form with diacritics on the wrong syllable only (user rule 2026-11-02, skill elevenlabs-tts §4.2/§7). Applied to the TTS text only; the screen keeps the normal spelling. Add every word flagged in voice/flags.json after a listen. Homographs: write the diacritic for the meaning in this script. Do NOT add homographs here (کرد، کشتی، مرد، شکر…): their reading depends on meaning, so mark them with diacritics in the script itself.
_note_finglish: Mahdi 2026-11-10: a Persian word the voice misreads is written in Finglish (Latin) on the TTS side, e.g. نجارها → najjarha (it read NEJJARHA). Screen text keeps Persian.
_note_2026_11_13: Mahdi 2026-11-13: «سم» was read SEM, must be SAM. Every short homograph-risk word in a script (سم، کرد، مرد، شکر، ملک، …) is written in Finglish or with the vowel diacritic for the meaning used, and checked in voice/flags.json before assembly.
